name: Jorba (Spain)
description: Quartered, the first and fourth quarters red with a white comet of the arms and the second and third light blue with the yellow open castle of the arms.
history: The flag was approved on 2 March 2001 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 3347 of 14 March 2001; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, quartered in cross, with the white comet of the arms 5/12 of the height centred in the red first and fourth quarters and the yellow open castle of the same arms in the second and third.

features.role: comet of the arms in the first and fourth quarters, 5/12 of the height
open castle of the arms in the second and third quarters
